title: build_email_from_create accepts client-supplied blobId (should be server-set)
description: email.rs build_email_from_create:661-665 reads blobId from the client-provided create object. RFC 8621 §5.5: blobId is a server-set property, not settable by the client on Email/set create. Accepting it is an IDOR vector (client references a blob from another account), misleads backends that check blob ownership, and produces inconsistency when the backend ignores it and assigns its own blobId. Fix: remove the blobId field extraction; always use a server-assigned placeholder that the backend overwrites.
